unreal.note: Set X/Y scale to scale_x_cm/scale_y_cm (1 Unreal unit = 1 cm). Z scale as given puts the terrain at true elevation span. Landscape origin = SW corner at (0,0); add elev_min_m*100 to Z location to place sea level at 0.

dem: USGS 3DEP (public domain), 1-10 m lidar/NED via National Map ImageServer
crs: WGS84 lat/lon → local equirectangular metres at mean latitude; adequate at ≤10 km extents
